summary: Male pattern hair loss with seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and face: long counselling, tangents on cost, helmet, travel to the US, diet, home remedies and the wedding, four new medicines, investigations and follow-up. Traps: dutasteride is discussed at length and explicitly not prescribed, so it must not be a row; biotin (self-started, now stopped), the family doctor's weekly vitamin D sachet and occasional pantoprazole are medicationHistory, not rows; PRP and hair transplant are discussed and declined, so procedurePlanned must stay empty; vitamin D is explicitly not ordered as a test; onion oil and bhringraj oil are not prescriptions; the family has baldness but explicitly no diabetes or thyroid, so both of those flags are false.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Hi, come in. Rahul, right? Please have a seat.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi doctor. Yes, Rahul. Thanks for seeing me, the appointment was full for two weeks.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Sorry about the wait, Saturdays are crazy. So tell me, what brings you here?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Mainly hair fall, doctor. For about eight months my hair is falling a lot. In the shower, on the pillow, everywhere. And in front, near the temples, it is going back. My friends have started joking about it.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay. Anything else apart from the hair fall?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Dandruff. Very bad dandruff. White and sometimes yellowish flakes, and the scalp is itchy. And there is some redness and flaking on my eyebrows and on the sides of the nose. I thought it is dry skin, but moisturiser is not helping.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How itchy is the scalp, if I ask you to give a number from zero to ten?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hmm, maybe six. More when I sweat, after the gym.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Six. Okay. Let us go step by step. The hair fall, did it start suddenly or slowly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I think slowly. But after I moved to Hyderabad last year it became more. In Bangalore it was not this bad.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Everybody blames the water. We will talk about that. Any major illness in the last one year? Fever, typhoid, dengue, covid, any surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I had dengue, but that was almost two years back. I was admitted for four days, platelets went down to forty thousand.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Two years back, okay. After that, did you have a phase of heavy shedding?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, two or three months after dengue it was very heavy, then it settled. This one is different, it is like the hair is becoming thin.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good observation. Any thyroid problem, sugar, BP, anything for you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No doctor. I did a full body check up last year in the office camp. Everything was normal except vitamin D was low.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: And what are you taking right now? Any tablets, supplements, anything at all?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Let me think. I am taking biotin tablets daily for four months. I started on my own, after reading online. Then vitamin D, one sachet every week, sixty thousand units, my family doctor gave that. He said eight weeks, I have two more weeks left. And sometimes pantoprazole when I have acidity, maybe once a week.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Biotin daily, vitamin D weekly sachet from your family doctor, pantoprazole occasionally. Got it. Any shampoo or oil you are using?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Head and Shoulders shampoo, almost daily. And my mother sends onion oil from home, I apply on weekends.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay. And in the family, anybody with hair loss? Father, uncles, grandfather?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Father, yes. He became bald at around thirty five. My mother's brother also, my mama, he is completely bald on top.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Father and maternal uncle. That is important. Any other illness in the family? Diabetes, thyroid?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, no diabetes or thyroid in the family. Everyone is fine, only the baldness.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Sorry to disturb, doctor. The lab person is here for the sample collection of the morning patients, shall I send him to room two?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, room two, and tell him I will sign the forms after this consultation. Thank you. Sorry Rahul, go on. What work do you do?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I am a software engineer. Product company in Hitech City. Long hours on the laptop, lot of meetings with the US team late in the evening.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: And sleep?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Six hours on a good day. Sometimes five.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Diet? Vegetarian or non vegetarian?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Pure vegetarian. We are from a Marwari family. But I go to the gym five days a week and I take whey protein, one scoop after the workout.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay. Let me examine now. Bend your head a little. Hmm. Let me use the dermoscope. Okay. There is thinning on the crown and recession at both temples. On the dermoscope, many hairs are thin and short, different thickness, that is called miniaturisation. Pull test is negative, so it is not a sudden shedding phase. The scalp has greasy yellowish scales, mainly behind the ears and on the crown, with mild redness. Eyebrows and the folds beside the nose have redness with fine greasy scales.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Is it very bad?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It is early to moderate. I would grade it as Norwood grade three. So two things are going on together. First, androgenetic alopecia, which is male pattern hair loss. It is genetic and hormone related, which fits with your father and uncle. Second, seborrheic dermatitis, which is the medical name for this kind of severe dandruff with redness on the scalp, eyebrows and nose.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: So the dandruff is causing the hair fall?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Not exactly. Dandruff can make the shedding a bit worse because of the itching and inflammation, but the thinning pattern is mainly the male pattern hair loss. We need to treat both. If we treat only the dandruff, the thinning will continue.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. And this water thing? Everybody in my office says Hyderabad water is hard and that is why everyone is losing hair.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Hard water can make hair feel rough and dry, and it can make the scalp a bit more irritated, but it does not cause male pattern baldness. If you want, a simple shower filter is okay, but don't spend thousands on it expecting new hair. The genes and hormones are the main reason.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Achha. My roommate bought a filter for four thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is his choice. It will not hurt, but it is not treatment. Now let me first take your BP, because one of the medicines I am thinking of can affect it slightly. Give me your arm.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: BP is one eighteen over seventy six. Good, normal.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, good to know. I was a little nervous.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No need. Now, let me explain the options, and then we decide together. For male pattern hair loss, two medicines have the strongest proof. One is minoxidil, applied on the scalp. The other is finasteride, a tablet, which blocks the hormone that shrinks the hair roots.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have heard about finasteride. People say it causes problems, you know, sexual problems. I am getting married in about a year.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good that you asked openly. In studies, a small number of men, around two to three in a hundred, notice reduced libido or some change. In most of them it goes away even while continuing, and certainly after stopping. Many of the scary stories online are not supported by evidence. It also does not affect your ability to have children in any meaningful way at this dose. But if you notice anything, you tell me, and we stop. It is not a one way door.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. That is reassuring. And there is another one, dutasteride? My colleague takes that.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes. Dutasteride is a stronger cousin of finasteride. It blocks the hormone more completely, and some studies show slightly better results. But it stays in the body for months, and the side effects, when they happen, take longer to go away. For a first time patient, at your age, with marriage planned, I prefer to start with finasteride. So I am not prescribing dutasteride today. If after six months to one year the response is poor, we can discuss it again.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Fine, no dutasteride for now. And PRP? There are so many ads on Instagram for PRP and hair transplant.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: PRP is an add on, it is not first line. It has some evidence, but it is costly, you need multiple sessions, and without the basic medicines the results don't last. I do not recommend PRP right now. Hair transplant is for later, if at all, when the pattern is stable, and only with medicines continuing. So today, no procedure.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: How much does PRP cost, just to know?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Depends on the place, roughly five to eight thousand per session, and they will ask you to do four to six sessions. Compare that with the medicines, which together will cost you maybe two to three thousand a month.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Two to three thousand every month? For how long?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is the honest part. Male pattern hair loss is a long term condition. As long as you want to keep the hair, you continue the treatment. If you stop, over six to twelve months you go back to where you would have been. Some brands are cheaper, I will write the ones that are reasonable.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hmm. Okay. I will think of it like the gym membership.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, in the medical shop there are so many minoxidil brands. Some are two hundred rupees, some are eight hundred. Which one is correct?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The molecule is the same. Any reputed brand of five percent solution is fine. What matters more is that you use it twice daily without missing. I will write the generic name, so the pharmacist can give you a reasonable brand.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, that helps. One more doubt. I ride a bike to office daily, twenty kilometres each way. Does the helmet cause hair fall? My cousin stopped wearing a helmet for this reason.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Please, never stop the helmet for hair. Helmets don't cause male pattern baldness. If it gets sweaty, wear a thin cotton cap or scarf inside and keep the helmet padding clean. Your head is more important than your hair.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haha, true. I will tell my cousin.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Exactly like that. Now, about the biotin. Your hair loss is not due to biotin deficiency, and biotin can also mess up some blood test results, especially thyroid tests. So please stop the biotin from today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Stop biotin. Okay. What about the vitamin D?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The vitamin D course your family doctor gave, finish the remaining two weeks as he told you. I am not adding anything to that. And keep the pantoprazole only for acidity, as you are doing.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Now, the diet. Vegetarian is absolutely fine for hair, but you need enough protein and iron. Dal, paneer, curd, soya, chana, rajma. Your whey protein is fine, one scoop is okay. It does not cause hair loss, that is a myth.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Really? One guy at the gym said whey and creatine cause hair fall.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Whey, no. Creatine, there was one small study that raised a question, but it is not proven. If you are very worried, you can skip the creatine. Also, crash diets are a big cause of hair shedding. Don't do those extreme cutting diets before the wedding.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haha. My mother will make sure I don't. She already says I have become too thin.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Listen to your mother. Okay, now I will tell you the tests. I want CBC, serum ferritin, and TSH. Ferritin tells us your iron stores, which matters a lot in vegetarians. Vitamin D you already know is low and you are on treatment, so no need to repeat vitamin D now.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: CBC, ferritin and TSH. Fasting required?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Not required for these. But stop the biotin at least three days before the TSH, otherwise the result can be wrong.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Got it. Biotin stop, then test after three days.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Correct. Now the prescription. Please listen carefully, I will also give it in writing. Number one, minoxidil five percent solution. One ml on the scalp, on the thinning areas, crown and temples, twice a day. Morning and night. For three months to start with.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: One ml, twice a day. How do I measure one ml?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The bottle comes with a dropper marked at one ml. Apply on a dry scalp, part the hair and put it on the skin, not on the hair. Leave it for at least four hours before washing. In the first one or two months you may see more shedding. Don't panic, that is the old weak hair falling to make way for new ones.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: That sounds scary. More hair fall first?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Temporary. It means the medicine is working. If you stop at that point, you lose the benefit. Some people get itching or irritation from the solution, and if it drips on the forehead, a little fine hair can grow there. So wash your hands after applying, and apply it carefully. If it irritates a lot, tell me, we can switch to a foam.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. And I use hair wax for office, for styling. Can I use it with the minoxidil?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, but apply the minoxidil first, let it dry for at least half an hour, then the wax. And wash the wax off properly at night before the night dose. Now, number two, Finax one milligram, that is finasteride. One tablet once daily after dinner, for three months to start.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Finax, one mg, after dinner. Every day?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Every day. If you miss one day, don't take two the next day, just continue. Number three, for the scalp dandruff, Revilus KZ lotion. It has ketoconazole and zinc pyrithione. Use it like a shampoo on the scalp three times a week. Apply, massage, leave it for five minutes, then wash off. For four weeks. On the other days use any mild shampoo, and stop the Head and Shoulders for now.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Revilus three times a week, leave for five minutes. Okay.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Number four, for the eyebrows and the sides of the nose, Cwin cream. It is ciclopirox, an antifungal. Apply a thin layer twice daily on the eyebrows and the sides of the nose, for two weeks.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Swin? With S?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: C W I N. Cwin cream. Twice a day, eyebrows and sides of the nose, two weeks. Avoid putting it inside the eyes.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, Cwin. Doctor, one thing about travel. My company might send me to the US for two months, from January. Can I carry these medicines?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, carry the full supply with the prescription. Minoxidil and finasteride are available there too, but more expensive. Keep the minoxidil bottle in the check in bag, it is a liquid. And keep the prescription with you in case customs asks.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: And the time difference? Night there is day here.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Doesn't matter. Take the Finax after dinner wherever you are, local time. Minoxidil morning and night, local time. Simple.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. And the onion oil my mother sends? She will be upset if I stop.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ha. Onion oil will not regrow hair, and on a scalp with seborrheic dermatitis, oils can actually make the dandruff worse. Tell your mother the doctor said no oil on the scalp for now. Use her oil on the ends of the hair if you like.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: She will call you herself, I am telling you.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: She is welcome. Now a few general things. Wash the scalp after gym on the days you sweat a lot, sweat and oil feed the dandruff. Don't use very hot water. Try to sleep at least seven hours. And stress, I know work is heavy, but stress makes both the shedding and the seborrheic dermatitis worse.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, my aunt in Jaipur is pushing me to try homeopathy and bhringraj oil. She says it worked for her son.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I respect that people try many things. But for male pattern hair loss, there is no good evidence for those. If you want to try a herbal oil on the ends of your hair, it is harmless, but do not replace the medicines with it. And don't apply any oil on the scalp while we are treating the dandruff.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Understood. And before the wedding, is there anything quick? Engagement photos are in March.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: By March you will be about four months into treatment, so the shedding should be less. For photos, a good haircut helps a lot, a little shorter on the sides makes the top look fuller. Some people use hair fibres for the day of the event, that is fine as a cosmetic trick. No magic beyond that, honestly.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. I will talk to my barber.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will try. Doctor, how soon will I see results?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The dandruff and the redness on the face should settle in two to three weeks. For the hair, be patient. Shedding reduces by three months, visible improvement by six months, best results by one year. Take photos of your crown and temples today in good light, same angle every month, so we can compare honestly.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, photos today. I will do that.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let me summarise once more. Stop biotin. Finish your vitamin D course. Minoxidil five percent solution, one ml on the scalp twice a day for three months. Finax one mg once daily after dinner for three months. Revilus KZ lotion three times a week on the scalp for four weeks. Cwin cream twice daily on eyebrows and sides of the nose for two weeks. No dutasteride, no PRP for now. Tests, CBC, ferritin, TSH. And review after three months with the reports and your photos.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Three months. Can I message you on WhatsApp if there is a problem before that?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Message the clinic number, the reception will pass it to me. If the reports come abnormal, come earlier, don't wait for three months.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sure. Thank you so much doctor, this was really helpful. Nobody explained it like this before.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: You are welcome. All the best for the wedding. See you in three months.
